findings.title: Misconfigured classpaths are no longer detected; same-order providers are picked arbitrarily
findings.body: The old check that threw when several CryptoProviders were present is gone. Default, Elytron and FIPS1402 providers all return order() == 200. If two of them end up on the classpath (for example default and FIPS), the sort leaves them tied and the winner depends on ServiceLoader discovery order, which depends on classpath order. Keycloak could then silently run non-FIPS crypto where FIPS was intended, and the only trace is a debug log line. Either keep failing when the top-ordered providers tie, or give each provider a distinct order.
